how: Skydive Dubai runs tandem skydives, AFF courses and USPA licence training from the Palm Dropzone, with jumps over Palm Jumeirah.
XLine Dubai Marina is a 1 km urban zipline from a 170 m start height across the Marina, reaching about 80 km/h, with harness and safety gear provided.
XPark at Kite Beach is a large urban sports facility with parkour, skateboarding, wall climbing and calisthenics zones on a day pass.
Ski Dubai in Mall of the Emirates has an 85 m indoor mountain with five runs (longest 400 m), a chairlift and a tow lift for skiers.
Ski Dubai Snow Park beside the slopes is a 3,000 square metre indoor snow play area with sled and toboggan runs, an ice slide, climbing towers and an ice cave, plus penguin encounters.
Dubai Safari Park offers bus and drive-through journeys past giraffes, lions, tigers and an Arabian desert area with oryx, a zoo-style safari rather than open-range wildlife.
Evening desert safaris from Dubai by Arabian Adventures are illustrated with family sandboarding on the dunes alongside dune driving and camel riding; the dunes lie some distance out of the city.
Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary has three free public birding hides overlooking greater flamingos, stilts, egrets, avocets and migratory shorebirds at the head of Dubai Creek.
Mirzam Chocolate Makers, a bean-to-bar factory in Al Quoz, runs chocolate factory tours with moulding, tasting and coffee-and-cocoa pairing workshops.
Volunteers.ae is the UAE national government-backed platform listing field and virtual volunteering with public and private organisations, open to residents of all nationalities.
Emirates Environmental Group (founded in Dubai in 1991) runs a Clean Up UAE campaign among its volunteer environmental projects; the page does not specify beach sites.
K9 Friends is a Dubai-linked dog rescue that homes rescued dogs through an adoption process.
K9 Friends lists a Get Involved page with several ways to help its rescue dogs.
The Hindu Temple in Jebel Ali (opened October 2022, with the Sikh gurudwara) hosts daily worship, festivals in its community hall and fire rituals; Krishna Mandir remains in Bur Dubai.
Bookends Dubai and several other Meetup book groups (Book Cellar, Dubai Bibliophiles, Iqraa Arabic Book Group) hold regular book club meetings in Dubai.
Quiz & Chill runs social trivia nights in Dubai listed on Meetup.
NISAA Fitness hosts ladies-only netball sessions listed on Meetup.
Founders Running Club Dubai and JBR Run & Pilates Club hold regular group runs listed on Meetup, and Kite Beach run clubs such as F45 Run Club meet weekly.
JBR Run & Pilates Club runs group Pilates sessions in Jumeirah Beach Residence, listed on Meetup.
Dubai Mindful Circle and other Meetup groups run mindfulness and guided meditation sessions in Dubai.
Dubai Outdoor Yoga & Meditation Community and Sunrise Soul Club run outdoor yoga sessions, and beach yoga events such as Dubai Yoga for Longevity meet at Jumeirah 2 Beach.
Practical Philosophy Club - Dubai and PhiloLifers Dubai host philosophy discussion events listed on Meetup.
Dubai Bibliophiles Book Club hosts poetry sessions listed on Meetup; no dedicated slam series was confirmed.
Curious Pickle runs a lecture series on psychology topics in Dubai, listed on Meetup.
Meetup.com lists dozens of active Dubai hobby groups, from badminton, hiking and improv to language exchange, philosophy and book clubs.
No snow or sled-dog culture exists in the UAE; the nearest option is in cold-climate Europe or Asia, many hours away by air.
No glaciers exist in the UAE or nearby Gulf region; the nearest glacier trekking is in the Alps or Central Asia, many hours away by air.
No volcanoes exist in the UAE; volcano boarding is done at sites such as Cerro Negro in Nicaragua, a long-haul flight away.
The UAE has no perennial rivers or rapids; white water rafting requires travel abroad.
Dubai has no natural hot springs; the nearest are at Ain Al Faidha near Al Ain, roughly 1.5 hours by road.
Spanish-style bullfighting does not exist in the UAE; the only bull sport nearby is traditional bull-butting in Fujairah, about 1.5 hours by road, which is a different sport.
